verses.1: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
verses.2: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
verses.3: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt;
verses.4: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
verses.5: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
verses.6: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people,
